NEW CUSTODY FINDING FROM THE OWNER URL: port 8765 is not serving the recovered branch or a committed 39c745d tree. It is Python PID 41564 serving /private/tmp/storymodel4s-docs-site.piSAsR/repo/docs-site. I inspected it read-only and did not touch or stop the owning session.

That checkout is HEAD 39c745d0 on scout/docs-site with THIRTEEN TRACKED MODIFIED docs-site files. The served getting-started page titled Inspect a source document differs materially from 39c745d0: it adds exact atlas output, token positions, span lookup, support examples, and fixture inspection. This is the page the owner just called better but extremely thin.

The complete uncommitted docs-site diff is 464 insertions / 394 deletions across 13 files. Canonical diff SHA256: 45472f66cc7f0295efd75103ef0213aca9cc663fdef72ee162a368032124949e. Served getting-started HTML SHA256: fea9bd0394ea7a43ba59c1934df7d749c904b184d2199ce6d44d85657ad9170e.

This means my earlier statement that the URL was simply an older committed build was wrong; correction: it is a dirty, uncommitted continuation over 39c745d. Its HTML source links still name 39c745d even though the visible content is absent from that commit, reproducing the provenance defect the repaired branch now prevents.

DO NOT KILL OR CLEAN PID 41564 OR THAT TEMP CHECKOUT. The content is not currently represented by the docs/provenance-derived history. Before any cleanup, a live owner or the chief should make an explicit custody decision: preserve the exact diff as a recoverable object, then compare/select its reader-facing improvements against the repaired branch. It still does not satisfy the six-workflow bar, but the improved introductory explanation should not be lost.
